Notes: The July 2026 magnitude rework constant: every Attack, Defense, HP and damage term multiplies it. Read by the client, src/battle.js (installed with setRules), src/power.js, src/apvp_sim.js and the sims; nothing types it.
Level core of a stat: Core_K x Stat_Scale x (L + Core_L0).
Level offset of the core.
Class/creature rating multiplier of a grade g: (Axis_A x g + Axis_B) / Axis_D.
Max HP: (HP_L_K x L + HP_L0) x (HP_D0 + Defense grade) / HP_Div x Stat_Scale.
A real character's share of the level core on Attack and Defense.
Attack bonus per Defense grade below 6 on a character (0 = off).
A character's HP multiplier.
Extra character HP per Defense grade below 6 (0 = off).
Innate character Attack and Defense floor, round(Char_Floor x Stat_Scale), added after the class and increased-% multipliers.
The class soul multiplier at the top of its ladder: 1 + (Cls_Soul_Top - 1) x i / n.
Damage: the defense floor and the reference defense, Def_Floor x Stat_Scale.
Damage: ((Dmg_Lv_K x L / Dmg_Lv_Div + Dmg_Lv_Add) x power x sqrt(atk / def)) / (Dmg_Div / Stat_Scale) + (Dmg_Flat_K x Stat_Scale + atk / Dmg_Atk_Div) / hits.
A plain heal move restores Heal_Frac x max HP, before heal amplifiers.
Tithe: +Tithe_Step Attack multiplier per stack.
Auto PvP and live PvP: every unit's max HP x APVP_HP_Mult (C1, D 2026-10-22).
Slagbite / Fracture: the target's Defense multiplier falls by this (additive inside the 0.3-2.5 status band). hardcode-3: was typed in src/battle.js and play/app.js statusMult.
Gravechill: the target's Attack multiplier falls by this.
Gravechill: Speed points lost.
Cinch: Speed points lost.
Doomrune (no payload): damage taken rises by this.
Warded (no payload): damage taken falls by this.
Pelagos (floor 104) Sealed Gate: a single hit below this share of his max HP is reduced to zero.
Sethek (floor 106) Ossuary Rebirth: he stands back up at this share of max HP.
Ostrakon (floor 110) Carapace Layers: separate damaging hits in one round that open the wall for the fight.
Ostrakon: the damage share a hit deals while the wall holds (75% reduced).
Eskaton (floor 120) The Unfinished Work: the forge rebuilds him every this many rounds.
Eskaton: damage inside one round, as a share of his max HP, that cancels the next rebuild.
Eskaton: a rebuild heals this share of his max HP.
A boss row with no Boss_HP: max HP = (Boss_HP_K x floor + Boss_HP_L0) x Stat_Scale. Boss_HP stays canonical.
A soul's own grade: SoulMult = 1 + Soul_Grade_Step x grade index (Worn x1.00 -> Void x2.00). The decimal is the exact double of 1/9.
The abyss past floor 120: every enemy stat x Abyss_Stat_Step per abyss floor above the first.
The class line reaches stage 2 at this class level (D ruling 2026-07-27).
The class line reaches stage 3 at this class level.
